decisions.decision: Replan Phase 11 from scratch rather than patching the existing 10 plans or appending a branding-delta plan
decisions.rationale: The 10-plan set (2de890c) was written against the original UI-SPEC, which was then rewritten twice for KONE Design System branding (93b5897 -> eb57ae8 -> 366d6f4). Eight of the ten plans cited the spec. Zero of their 23 tasks had run, so there was no shipped code to protect -- replanning cost nothing and patching would have left the old visual contract encoded in the plan text. Operator chose this at the plan gate.

decisions.decision: Deleted the old 11-01..11-10-PLAN.md from the working tree before spawning the planner
decisions.rationale: The new set has 9 plans, not 10. Letting the planner overwrite in place would have left a stale 11-10-PLAN.md on disk that execute-phase would then try to run. They remain recoverable at commit 2de890c.

decisions.decision: Embedded the UI-SPEC's orphaned concrete values directly into 11-03/11-07/11-08 instead of leaving a pointer
decisions.rationale: The current UI-SPEC's 'Page-specific main-area contracts' section defers to 'the original sections' surviving text' for device-table columns, default sort, history-strip segment sizing and overview grid values -- but that text does not survive on disk; it only exists at git 12830c1. The planner recovered it and inlined the values; the plan-checker independently confirmed they are present concretely. No executor has to go spelunking in git history.

decisions.decision: Added 11-01 to 11-04's depends_on, and backfilled literal D-06/D-07/D-16 citations into must_haves.truths
